title: lockdowns-as-partial-holidays
description: Research code for the Holiday-Equivalent Stoppage (HES) framework, which treats a lockdown as a partial holiday. A work-stoppage elasticity identified from recurring holidays (Thai public holidays including Songkran, and the Chinese New Year window) through one shared Prophet regressor per channel is transferred to the pandemic with a dose, the Holiday-Equivalent Stoppage Index computed from Google Community Mobility. Includes the Monte Carlo study, robustness experiments, theory checks, the paper build and a runner for official export data. Companion software to the preprint "Lockdowns as Partial Holidays: Identifying Work-Stoppage Elasticities from Recurring Holidays and Transferring Them to Forecast Thailand's Monthly Exports through the COVID-19 Shock".
